title: Taratura di un estensimetro
promptHtml: Fai il fit lineare con np.polyfit dei dati di taratura (eps in µε, V in mV) e metti la sensibilità in k (mV/µε) e l'offset in q. Poi converti la lettura V_lett = 2.4 mV in deformazione eps_lett.
starter:
import numpy as np
eps = np.array([0, 250, 500, 750, 1000.0])
V = np.array([0.05, 0.66, 1.29, 1.90, 2.53])
k, q = ...
V_lett = 2.4
eps_lett = ...
print(k, q, eps_lett)
tests:
import numpy as np
ka, qa = np.polyfit(eps, V, 1)
assert abs(k - ka) < 1e-12 and abs(q - qa) < 1e-12, "usa np.polyfit(eps, V, 1)"
assert abs(eps_lett - (2.4 - qa) / ka) < 1e-6, "eps = (V − q) / k"
solution:
import numpy as np
eps = np.array([0, 250, 500, 750, 1000.0])
V = np.array([0.05, 0.66, 1.29, 1.90, 2.53])
k, q = np.polyfit(eps, V, 1)
V_lett = 2.4
eps_lett = (V_lett - q) / k
print(k, q, eps_lett)
